title: Mouse without borders says keys dont match, when it does
author: Jebarson
summary: Mouse Without Borders first showed InvalidKey while the two machines were on different releases; after both machines were updated to 0.101.2362.0, the reporter says pairing still fails, so the original version-mismatch explanation is no longer sufficient.

comment.body:
Thanks for the original pairing details and for confirming that the problem still occurs after updating both machines to PowerToys 0.101.2362.0. The earlier mixed-version explanation no longer distinguishes the current failure from stale restored pairing state or another handshake problem.

Please provide:
1. Reproduce the failure with both machines on 0.101.2362.0, then add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward on each affected machine if possible.
2. Confirm whether pairing fails in both directions after a fresh restart, and whether removing and re-adding the peer changes the result. Please do not regenerate the key unless you are reporting that as a separate test result.

This evidence will identify whether the current failure is persisted pairing/key state or a same-version Mouse Without Borders handshake defect.
